activity.notes: Maria Theresa initially succeeded to the Bohemian crown in 1740. During the War of the Austrian Succession, Karl Albrecht of Bavaria received the homage of the Bohemian Estates as king in 1741 and the House of Austria temporarily lost the title. ATLAS therefore does not flatten 1740-1780 into an uninterrupted Bohemian reign.

sources.title: Maria Theresa — Die Welt der Habsburger
sources.citation_text: The Habsburg history portal identifies Maria Theresa as ruler of the Habsburg Monarchy from 1740 to 1780, Queen of Hungary and Bohemia, and Archduchess of Austria.

sources.title: The War of Austrian Succession — Die Welt der Habsburger
sources.citation_text: The Habsburg history portal records that Karl Albrecht received the homage of the Bohemian Estates as King of Bohemia in 1741, meaning the House of Austria lost that title, and that Maria Theresa recovered power and was crowned Queen of Bohemia in May 1743.
